title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go + parity & v1.62.0 bump
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Unifies SDK auth, retry, and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go; fixes parity gaps; bumps SDK versions to v1.62.0. No breaking API changes expected.
description: Context: customers and internal teams requested a consistent developer experience across our SDKs for auth handling, retry behavior, and streaming APIs (ENG-1289, ENG-1294). This PR: 1) consolidates auth initialization and refresh token handling so patterns are identical in python/ts/go; 2) standardizes retry/backoff config (max_attempts, backoff_factor, retryable_statuses) and exposes a single RetryConfig surface; 3) stabilizes streaming ergonomics (async iterators in python, async generators/promises in TS, channel-based streaming helper in Go) so examples and docs can be copy-pasted between languages; 4) addresses parity fixes found during docs sprint (method names, error types); 5) bumps package versions to v1.62.0 for all SDKs and updates changelogs. Checklist: [x] API/ergonomics design review by Priya; [x] unit and integration tests updated; [x] docs examples updated; [x] changelogs and version bumps; [x] CI green. Testing notes: ran full unit suite locally and on CI, exercised streaming scenarios against canary runtime and verified graceful reconnect, validated retry counters and metrics (retry_count counter exposed). Related: docs PR #312 in redwood-docs, quickstarts update in redwood-quickstarts. See commits for granular changes.
commits: feat(sdk): extract shared auth adapter and common RetryConfig
refactor(python): implement async generator helper for streaming parity
refactor(ts): align auth initialization and introduce RetryConfig type
feat(go): add streaming helper + retry middleware
test(sdk): add parity tests for streaming and retry behavior
chore(release): bump python/ts/go to v1.62.0 and update changelogs
review_comments: Liam: Overall looks good; please add an explicit section in CHANGELOG noting retry default change.
Author(Ava): Added changelog entries for each SDK and a migration note for teams overriding retry defaults.
Priya: Can we avoid breaking existing user code that passed positional args to auth constructors? Please add compatibility wrappers.
Author(Ava): Added compatibility constructors in python and TS and documented the deprecation in changelog; Go uses an adapter pattern so no break.
Mateo: Minor nit on Go naming (StreamClient vs StreamingClient) — prefer StreamingClient for parity.
Author(Ava): Renamed Go type and added alias to preserve compatibility; updated tests.
Priya: CI flaked on windows go build once — reran and all green.
Liam: Approved after changelog and compatibility fixes.
CI: All checks passed; ready to merge.
merge_commit_message:
sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go + parity fixes and version bumps to v1.62.0

Consolidates auth flows, unifies RetryConfig, stabilizes streaming helpers, fixes parity issues across SDKs, updates changelogs and bumps versions.
notes_for_release_manager: Coordinate simultaneous package publishes for Python (PyPI), TypeScript (npm), and Go modules; docs PR and quickstarts updated in separate PRs linked in description; monitor canary for 48h for retry-related metrics.
local_testing_steps: cd sdk/typescript && npm run test && npm run build
run canary streaming smoke test against staging runtime
impact_summary: Low-risk ergonomics and parity work; includes deprecation wrappers to avoid breaking existing clients; observability metrics (retry_count) added to aid rollout monitoring.
